I don't even know what the hell any of this is. I never even heard of or where this had happened.

"aen and his army" He doesn't even have an army, he doesn't even have alternate accounts to "spam". It's most likely other users who CHOSE to take his side of the conflict. Actually I don't think this should be a conflict at all. Just some unneccessary situation that shouldn't even be a problem about an image. I don't even see spam at all in the logs.

I don't even know how all this even started. I'll talk to him to understand, but where ever this unneccessary thing is, you should form it into a more civilized discussion (while not antagonizing the 'other side'). 

But please, never talk to me (on here) again.
